title: Asked for a retry library; two more came with it
note: Written for this page. The issue names tenacity; the change also adds pandas and boto3.
issue:
Retry failed uploads in the export job

Uploads to the bucket fail now and then. Retry them with tenacity, three tries, backing off.
diff:
diff --git a/requirements.txt b/requirements.txt
index 1111111..2222222 100644
--- a/requirements.txt
+++ b/requirements.txt
@@ -1,3 +1,6 @@
 requests==2.32.3
 click==8.1.7
+tenacity==8.2.3
+pandas==2.2.2
+boto3==1.34.131
 jinja2==3.1.4
diff --git a/export/upload.py b/export/upload.py
index 1111111..2222222 100644
--- a/export/upload.py
+++ b/export/upload.py
@@ -1,3 +1,5 @@
 import requests
+from tenacity import retry, stop_after_attempt, wait_exponential
 
+@retry(stop=stop_after_attempt(3), wait=wait_exponential())
 def upload(path, url):

title: The issue asked for the dependency

Parse dates with python-dateutil

The hand-written parser misses time zones; use python-dateutil instead.

index 1111111..2222222 100644
